title: console tooling standup 2026-04-14
body:
Console & Tooling Engineering Standup - 2026-04-14

Attendees: Jordan Kim (owner), Ayesha Patel, Miguel Torres, Sana Rahman, Eric Zhao, plus guests: PM - Priya Rao

Agenda:
- Quick updates: UI work, rollout infra, analytics pipeline
- Blockers / needs
- Action items and owners

1) UI (Ayesha)
- Progress: New Rollout Details card implemented (WIP). Frontend PR #274 opened, awaiting design QA. E2E flaky on mobile viewport (failing in Cypress runs on staging).
- Metrics: Render time improved after lazy-loading the large histogram component (~120ms -> ~70ms median).
- Next: Accessibility pass + fix keyboard nav (due 2026-04-20).
- Blocker: Design QA backlog — pinged Priya for review; need final colors for canary state.

2) Rollouts / Feature Flags (Miguel)
- Progress: Canary rollout for model-routing UI deployed to 10% traffic. Initial telemetry shows correct routing for 98% requests.
- Incident: One rollback due to mismatch in model-variant mapping (CONSOLE-412). Root cause: stale route cache on dedicated nodes. Patch deployed; monitoring in place.
- Next: Add safe-guard check in API to reject inconsistent mappings (RFC drafted).
- Blocker: Need a short maintenance window to flush caches in Dedicated; coordinating with SRE.

3) Analytics / Observability (Sana)
- Progress: Event schema change for token attribution shipped to staging. New cost-per-token metric is now in the dashboard (analytics-ops dashboard).
- Data issue: Discrepancy between streaming and non-streaming token counts (~3% delta) — investigating deserialization timing. Traces point to client-side batching differences.
- Next: Run backfill job to recompute last 7 days for affected routes (ticket ANALYTICS-233).
- Blocker: Backfill job needs more quota from infra; raised request to infra team.

4) Ops / infra notes (Eric)
- Observed slow query on per-route cost aggregation (spikes during peak ingestion). Created query optimization ticket and short-term cache layer.
- Dedicated autoscaler logs show occasional flapping when canaries spike usage — tuning policy suggested.

Open Blockers (summary):
- Flaky E2E tests for rollout details on mobile (Ayesha) — impacts release verification.
- Cache inconsistency causing wrong model-variant routing (Miguel) — mitigated, but needs robust fix.
- Analytics backfill quota request (Sana) — blocking accurate cost reports.

Action Items:
- Ayesha: Finish accessibility fixes and address E2E flakiness (due 2026-04-20). Linked PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/274
- Miguel: Implement API-level consistency check for model-variant mappings and submit patch (due 2026-04-18). Reference ticket: CONSOLE-412
- Sana: Coordinate infra quota for backfill and run recompute for last 7 days (due 2026-04-16). Ticket: ANALYTICS-233
- Eric: Deploy short-term cache for per-route cost aggregation to reduce slow query impact (due 2026-04-15).
- Jordan: Coordinate with SRE for a 30-min maintenance window to flush dedicated caches (proposed window 2026-04-17 02:00-02:30 UTC).

Notes / FYI:
- PM Priya requested a short one-pager summarizing canary behaviour and rollback criteria for next week's exec sync. Jordan to draft.
- Suggestion: add a lightweight synthetic test that runs the new Rollout Details flow on mobile viewport after every canary deploy to catch regressions earlier. (Raised by Ayesha)

Next meeting: 2026-04-21 10:00 UTC

End of notes.
